items.item: International Time Definite fuel surcharge (UK account holders, jet fuel indexed, weekly)
items.change: +1.25 pt vs prior week (45.00%); 48.00% already published for 5 to 11 Oct 2026
items.note: Weekly indexation on US Gulf Coast jet fuel. US table for the same week: export 35.00%, import 38.75%, rising to 36.25% and 40.00% for 5 to 11 Oct. DHL cut its US fuel tables by 2 points from 3 Aug 2026.

items.item: 2027 general price increase
items.value: 5.9% average (UK and US)
items.src: DHL Express US press release; Air Cargo Week (UK)
items.note: US announced 25 Sep 2026, UK announced 30 Sep 2026 (https://aircargoweek.com/dhl-express-average-rate-increase-of-5-9-percent-for-2027-in-united-kingdom/). DHL cites inflation, currency, energy, customs compliance and security costs; a limited number of surcharges also change.

items.item: Peak demand surcharge, international Time Definite
items.value: Europe to Americas USD 0.55/kg; within Europe USD 0.30/kg; China/HK to Americas USD 2.25/kg; Americas to Europe nil
items.src: DHL Express US demand surcharge page
items.note: German DHL Express page lists EUR 0.10 to 2.00/kg by lane for international over the same window and EUR 0.10/kg domestic from 1 Nov to 31 Dec 2026.

items.item: Elevated Risk surcharge on shipments to and from Israel
items.value: Suspended
items.note: DHL says it will keep monitoring the safety situation; DHL Global Forwarding reported in May 2026 that container traffic was still not transiting the Strait of Hormuz.

items.item: International export and import fuel surcharge (single table)
items.note: Since 22 Jun 2026 FedEx applies one table to exports and imports, moving exports onto the former import level (Supply Chain Dive).

items.item: 2027 general rate increase, US, export and import package services
items.value: 5.9% average
items.note: New USD 25 paper document fee for non-electronic trade documents and a residential delivery charge for select international destinations.

items.item: International demand surcharges, US export and import
items.value: China/HK/Macau priority imports USD 0.91/lb (from 0.35); Asia-Pacific priority imports USD 0.73/lb (from 0.20)
items.src: LJM blog; FedEx demand surcharges page
items.note: FedEx confirms the 21 Sep 2026 adjustment on https://www.fedex.com/en-us/shipping/rate-changes/demand-surcharges.html; lane tables are in PDFs.

items.item: International Air export and import fuel surcharge
items.value: Export 45.00%; import 47.75%
items.note: US retail diesel reached USD 6.529 per gallon on 21 Sep. UPS had not announced a 2027 general rate increase as of 29 Sep 2026.

items.item: International surge fees (peak) and flat per-package surge emergency fees on US exports
items.value: Peak surge fees by service and lane; USD 0.50/lb on US-origin Worldwide Economy DDP/DDU; emergency fees USD 8.75 additional handling, USD 96 large package, USD 514 over max
items.effective: surge fees 27 Sep 2026 to 16 Jan 2027; emergency fees since 31 May 2026
items.note: TransImpact reports the surge emergency programme began as per-pound charges on Middle East routes before moving to flat per-package fees (https://transimpact.com/blog/ups-adds-new-surge-emergency-fees-and-higher-fuel-surcharges).

items.item: Parcel price increase (stamps unchanged)
items.value: about +8% on parcels; First Class small parcel GBP 5.45 to 5.90; 1st and 2nd Class letter stamps unchanged at GBP 1.80 and 0.91
items.note: Announced 4 Sep 2026; Tracked, Signed For and Special Delivery also rise; Mailmark franking prices unchanged.

items.item: Service to the USA: US customs requirement change
items.value: US customs requirements change; PDDP services offered
items.note: Royal Mail ships goods to the US with prepaid duties.

items.item: Peak surcharges
items.value: UK GBP 0.03 per parcel; Germany GBP 0.22; Denmark, Finland, Sweden GBP 0.30 per shipment
items.effective: UK 15 Nov to 10 Jan; international 1 Nov to 31 Dec
items.src: Evri accessorial charges 2026 (reseller schedule updated June 2026)
items.note: Same schedule lists a GBP 0.35 Clean Air Levy for zero-emission delivery in ULEZ/CAZ postcodes.

items.item: 2027 universal service tariffs
items.value: +6.73% average; Lettre Verte EUR 1.52 to 1.67; Colissimo for consumers +4.1%; mainland to overseas parcels -5%; business mail +5.1%
items.note: Announced 27 Jul 2026 within ARCEP's multi-year price cap (liti.fr).

items.item: 2027 regulated tariff headroom set by ACM
items.value: EUR 3.5929 weighted average (2026: EUR 3.1882), about +12.7%
items.note: Published 26 Aug 2026; not a stamp price; PostNL sets individual tariffs within the cap.

items.item: Letter format reform: Maxibrief withdrawn
items.value: at least EUR 1.29 more per shipment for senders of goods using Maxibrief
items.note: Großbrief dimensions widened; Dialogpost prices rise about 3.5% on average from 1 Jan 2027 (Dialoghaus). Bundesnetzagentur decision on 2027 letter postage still pending in our sources.

items.item: Union handling fee per low-value e-commerce item
items.value: EUR 2 per item (draft delegated act)
items.change: new cost item, on top of EUR 3 customs duty per item since 1 Jul 2026
items.src: European Commission, EU Customs Reform page; VATupdate
items.note: Commission page: fee to be introduced by 1 Nov 2026 via delegated act, based on customs supervision costs. Amount of EUR 2 published 21 Sep 2026 (Agence Europe, VATupdate).

items.item: FedEx Ground / Home Delivery fuel surcharge
items.note: Indexed weekly to the US on-highway diesel average.

items.item: FedEx Express US domestic package fuel surcharge
items.note: International export/import is 45.50% the same week (+1.0 pt).

items.item: UPS US domestic Ground fuel surcharge
items.note: UPS's own page did not render a current table for us; US diesel averaged USD 6.529 per gallon on 21 Sep (EIA). UPS domestic air value not verified.

items.item: UPS international air import fuel surcharge
items.note: Described as a record; international air export at 45%.

items.item: 2027 general rate increase (US, US export, US import packages)
items.value: +5.9% average
items.note: Zone reclassification 1 Feb 2027. UPS had not published its 2027 increase as of 29 Sep 2026.

items.item: Ground / Home Delivery residential delivery charge
items.value: USD 6.90 per package (from USD 6.45)
items.note: Residential delivery area surcharge rises from USD 6.60 to 7.00, extended from USD 8.80 to 9.60.

items.item: 2026 demand surcharges (US domestic)
items.value: Ground Residential USD 0.50 to 0.80; Additional Handling USD 8.80 / 11.85 peak; Oversize USD 95.75 / 117.25 peak
items.effective: Additional Handling and Oversize from 28 Sep; Ground Residential from 26 Oct 2026; to 17 Jan 2027 (peak 23 Nov to 27 Dec)
items.note: Ground Economy USD 2.55 to 4.05 per package.

items.item: 2026 peak and demand surcharges
items.value: Demand USD 0.50 to 2.50 per package (high-volume up to USD 9.35); Additional Handling USD 8.75 to 11.90; Large Package USD 96.25 to 117.50
items.effective: size charges from 27 Sep; demand from 25 Oct 2026 to 16 Jan 2027 (peak 22 Nov to 26 Dec)
items.change: service-level charges up about 22 to 25% vs 2025
items.note: High-volume tier applies to customers over 20,000 packages a week.

items.item: 2026 peak surcharges
items.value: USD 0.50 / 0.75 / 0.50 per package; Additional Handling up to USD 11.90; Large Package up to USD 117.50
items.effective: 25 Oct 2026 to 16 Jan 2027 (peak 22 Nov to 26 Dec)
items.note: No volume-based surcharge for a second year; accessorials closely mirror UPS and FedEx.

items.item: 2026-27 peak demand surcharges
items.value: Residential USD 1.00 flat; Additional Handling USD 11; Large Package USD 110; Over Max USD 595
items.change: Residential and Additional Handling flat; Large Package +4.8%; Over Max +8.2%

items.item: Temporary holiday price change (Priority Mail Express, Priority Mail, Ground Advantage, Parcel Select)
items.value: Retail Priority Mail +USD 0.50 to 3.90 (zones 1 to 4), +USD 1.00 to 9.10 (zones 5 to 9)
items.change: Lightweight Ground Advantage to distant zones up to 57% above last year's peak increment
items.note: USPS raises published prices rather than adding demand surcharges. No January 2027 price filing found as of 1 Oct.

items.item: Temporary transportation-related price increase
items.note: Applies to Priority Mail Express, Priority Mail, Ground Advantage and Parcel Select; justified by fuel costs.

items.item: 2027 general average price adjustment for US account holders
items.value: +5.9% average

items.item: US-bound postal items: duty prepayment requirement
items.value: Prepayment required for items valued USD 100 to 2,500
items.effective: 24 Jul 2026 (acceptance resumed 14 Apr 2026 after Aug 2025 suspension)
items.note: Example of foreign posts rebuilding US service around the CBP postal entry rule.

items.item: Malaysia emergency fuel surcharge, West to East Malaysia and intra-Sabah/Sarawak deliveries
items.value: RM1.95 per kg (plus 6% SST)
items.note: Reviewed weekly against S&P Global Platts jet fuel; applies to successful deliveries and returns to sender.

items.item: Fuel-related surcharge increase
items.note: Reported alongside the Ninja Van surcharge; base surcharge level not stated in source.

items.item: Thailand per-parcel fuel adjustment
items.value: +3 baht per parcel
items.note: KEX said it would consider reducing or cancelling the charge if fuel prices normalise; no withdrawal found in sources checked.

items.item: Vietnam domestic fuel surcharge, all domestic services
items.note: H1 2026 net profit still fell 33%.

items.item: Indonesia seller logistics service fee (percentage of buyer-paid shipping)
items.value: Capped at Rp5,055 per order (TikTok Shop) and Rp10,110 (Tokopedia), before tax; route rates from Rp260
items.note: Paid by the seller and not shown to buyers at checkout.

items.item: Indonesia failed-delivery and buyer-preference return charges to sellers
items.value: Up to Rp5,000 each (up to Rp10,000 per transaction)
items.effective: 1 Jun 2026, with three-month waiver; system active 1 Sep 2026
items.note: Instant orders exempt; amounts above Rp5,000 absorbed by the platform.

items.item: Gratis Ongkir XTRA (optional free-shipping programme) seller fee
items.value: Example: fashion accessories 7.5% (regular items), 9% (special items); jewellery 2% (max Rp40,000) and 3.5% (max Rp60,000)
items.note: New split between regular items and special items over 5kg or 60cm.

items.item: PiShip shipping service fee and Voucher Xtra fee
items.value: Increased (rates published only as images in source)
items.note: Part of a wider fee round that also changed commissions and seller co-funding of discount codes (40%, capped at VND50,000 per product).

items.item: Minimum price for cross-border goods sold via e-commerce platforms (Permendag 19/2026)
items.value: US$100 FOB per unit
items.note: Also requires fee transparency and seller approval of fee changes, and platform monitoring of below-cost sales.

items.item: Import duty on low-value online imports
items.value: Duty from 1 baht (previous exemption up to 1,500 baht)
items.note: Lazada, Shopee, Shein, TikTok Shop and Temu collect at checkout; Thailand Post may collect on delivery for postal items.

items.carrier: Brazil federal government (Receita Federal, Remessa Conforme)
items.item: Federal import tax on cross-border purchases up to USD 50 via certified platforms
items.value: 0% (was 20%); state ICMS of 17 to 20% still applies
items.effective: 0% since MP 1.357 of 12 May 2026; made law (PLV 13/2026) signed 10 Sep 2026
items.note: The law also cuts the rate for USD 50 to 3,000 from 60% towards 30% and lets the Finance Ministry set rates and purchase-frequency limits; Forbes Brasil (4 Sep) reports ICMS at 17 to 20% depending on state.

items.item: Customs duty exemption threshold for e-commerce shipments into Dubai
items.value: AED 1,000 (was AED 300)
items.note: Excludes tobacco, e-cigarettes, nicotine liquids and alcohol; companies must register with Dubai Customs. Prior AED 300 threshold per VATupdate (12 Sep 2026).

items.item: Import tariffs on 1,463 tariff lines from countries without a trade agreement with Mexico (incl. China)
items.value: up to 50% (textiles, clothing, personal care); up to 30% (appliances, toys); up to 25% (jewellery, furniture)
items.note: Computers and mobile phones exempt under the ITA (16% VAT only). Sits on top of the 33.5% courier import rate on Chinese parcels introduced in August 2025.

items.item: Express service fee increases per parcel, B2B/e-commerce volumes
items.value: Jiangsu +RMB 0.10 minimum; Anhui +RMB 0.15 minimum; Henan (Zhengzhou, Xuchang, Luoyang) +RMB 0.20 to 0.30 on 0 to 3 kg outbound
items.note: State Post Bureau data: Jan to Aug 2026 express revenue +7.4% vs volume +4.6%; individual consumer sends largely unaffected.
